gift.title: Open the gift
gift.intro: Tap the box, watch the lid lift, and read what's inside.
gift.letterText:
Dear Aien,

This letter has been waiting inside a little box until the perfect moment. Every memory with you feels like a page in our story. I love the way you laugh, the way your hand fits mine, and the way the world feels softer when you're near.

Happy Birthday. This is for you.

Akhum Anar ❤️
